title: Training plateaued after 14 epochs because 77K auxiliary images ate the capacity
symptom: cwd12 holdout mAP50-95 moved 0.5145 -> 0.5539 in 14 epochs / 26 h 28 m and then stopped improving.
root_cause: The merged 84K corpus carried ~7K weed instances across 12 classes against 77K auxiliary images, with a 20:1 imbalance between Carpetweeds (1,474) and Goosegrass (75).
correction_made: Class-balanced oversampling of weak classes and a progressive Phase 2 (job 40357694).
